alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

logs: EVENT BackOff Pod/checkout-748c57d7fd-bmwck: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-748c57d7fd-bmwck_warden-pg(<UUID_1>)
EVENT BackOff Pod/checkout-748c57d7fd-zrwc5: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-748c57d7fd-zrwc5_warden-pg(<UUID_2>)
checkout-748c57d7fd-zrwc5/checkout 2026-09-24T12:30:36.158450456Z checkout: WARN memory pressure rising
checkout-748c57d7fd-bmwck/checkout 2026-09-24T12:30:22.145962233Z checkout: WARN memory pressure rising

root_cause.hypothesis: checkout container OOM-killed: app allocates ~900MiB cache on startup but pod memory_limit_mib is 48 — way undersized. Recent deploy (rev 2) only bumped python image tag (3.12-alpine → 3.12.7-alpine), unrelated to memory config, so deploy itself likely not root cause — the limit was already too low for this workload.
evidence: memory_limit_mib: 48 vs log line 'allocating 900MiB cache' — ~19x over limit
restart_count 8, BackOff events on both pods — crash loop pattern consistent w/ repeat OOM+restart
both pods (bmwck, zrwc5) show identical WARN memory pressure rising → allocate 900MiB sequence before kill
ruled_out: Image/version change as direct cause — tag diff is patch-level (3.12→3.12.7 alpine), no known behavior change flagged in evidence
crashloop_containers metric shows 0, so orchestrator may not yet be labeling as full crashloop despite BackOff events — minor inconsistency, not enough to change hypothesis

proposal.reasoning: OOM kills: app allocates ~900MiB cache at startup, pod memory_limit_mib only 48. Deploy rev2 only bumped python patch tag, unrelated to memory config — limit was already undersized for workload. Raising memory limit addresses root cause.
proposal.expected_effect: Pods stop OOM-killing, restart_count stabilizes, pods_ready returns to 2/2.

reasons: Passed all policies. Held for operator approval before execution.
